lines.text: The LORD rides on a swift cloud to Egypt, and the idols of Egypt tremble before Him.
The Egyptians turn to idols and spirits of the dead, and the waters of the Nile dry up.
The princes of Memphis are mere fools, and the LORD pours into Egypt a spirit of confusion.
The land of Moab brings terror to Egypt, and five Egyptian cities swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts.
A highway joins Egypt and Assyria, and the LORD blesses Egypt, Assyria and Israel.
